hero.eyebrow: For people who've studied English but freeze up when speaking
hero.title: Speak English without fear of mistakes.
hero.description: Chat with an AI about whatever you like, at your level. Corrections only come at the end — with examples, turned into flashcards so you don't forget.

converse.title: 1 · Talk
converse.description: Pick a topic and speak freely, by text or voice. The AI chats with you — without correcting anything along the way.

understand.title: 2 · Understand
understand.description: At the end, the AI reviews the whole conversation, highlights what can improve, and explains with examples.

review.title: 3 · Review
review.description: The points become spaced-repetition flashcards. The same mistake in different conversations reinforces the same card.

noJudgment.title: Judgment-free conversation
noJudgment.description: Practice about anything you want, at your level. Corrections never interrupt the conversation.

textOrVoice.title: Text or voice
textOrVoice.description: Speak or type — your choice. Voice transcription keeps your mistakes on purpose, so the analysis is real.

explainedAnalysis.title: Analysis that explains why
explainedAnalysis.description: Every correction comes with an explanation and an example, not just the right sentence.

stickyProgress.title: Progress that sticks
stickyProgress.description: Flashcards with FSRS (the same algorithm Anki uses), XP, and streaks — so practice becomes a habit.

pricing.heading: One plan, no catch
pricing.description: Full access from day one. Cancel anytime, no penalty.
features: Flashcards with spaced repetition (the same algorithm Anki uses)

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These Terms of Use govern access to and use of Fluency Mind ("we", "our"), an app for practicing English by conversing with an artificial intelligence. By creating an account or using the service, you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use Fluency Mind.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
sections.body: Fluency Mind is offered by Diego, an individual, who can be reached at contato@thefluencymind.com for any question about these terms or about the service.

sections.title: 2. Your account
sections.body: To use the service you need to create an account with an email and password, or sign in with your Google account. You're responsible for keeping your password secure and for everything that happens on your account. Tell us right away if you suspect unauthorized use. You must be at least 18 years old to create an account; the service is not directed at children or teenagers.

sections.title: 3. How the service works
sections.body: Fluency Mind lets you chat in English with an AI agent about free or suggested topics, by text or voice. At the end of each conversation, a second AI analyzes what you wrote, highlights passages with possible errors or naturalness suggestions, explains them in Portuguese, and suggests flashcards for spaced review. The service is a practice tool and does not replace classes, certifications, or a formal proficiency assessment.

sections.title: 4. AI-generated content
sections.body: Responses from the conversation AI and analyses from the correction AI are generated automatically and may contain errors, inaccuracies, or suggestions that don't apply to your context. Use your own judgment. Don't treat AI-generated content as professional advice of any kind.

sections.title: 5. Subscription and payment
sections.body: Fluency Mind is offered as a recurring monthly subscription, billed in US dollars through Stripe, our payment processor. We don't store your card details — they're handled directly by Stripe. The subscription renews automatically until you cancel it; you can cancel anytime from the subscription area, and access stays active until the end of the period already paid for. We may change the subscription price with reasonable prior notice; the change only applies to the next billing cycle.

sections.title: 6. Acceptable use
sections.body: You agree not to: use the service for illegal purposes; try to access other people's accounts or data that isn't yours; reverse-engineer, scrape data in bulk, or use bots to interact with the service; send offensive, discriminatory, or illegal content in conversations; or try to overload or compromise the platform's security. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these rules.

sections.title: 7. Intellectual property
sections.body: Fluency Mind's code, design, brand, and content (such as conversation topics and interface text) belong to us. The messages you write or speak remain yours; by sending them, you grant us a license to process them in order to provide the service (generating responses, analyzing errors, creating flashcards), as described in our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 8. Service availability
sections.body: We do our best to keep the service available, but we don't guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation. We may change, suspend, or discontinue features, including during maintenance or changes to external providers (such as the AI or voice transcription provider).

sections.title: 9. Limitation of liability
sections.body: Fluency Mind is provided "as is". To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect damages, data loss, or lost profits arising from use of the service, including decisions made based on AI-generated corrections or suggestions.

sections.title: 10. Termination
sections.body: You can close your account whenever you want by requesting deletion at our contact email. We may suspend or terminate your access in case of a violation of these terms, a failed subscription payment, or a decision to discontinue the service, giving reasonable advance notice whenever possible.

sections.title: 11. Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these Terms of Use from time to time. Material changes will be communicated by email or a notice within the service itself. Continued use after a change means you agree to the new terms.

sections.title: 12. Governing law and contact
sections.body: These terms are governed by Brazilian law. Questions, requests, or complaints can be sent to contato@thefluencymind.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what personal data Fluency Mind collects, why we collect it, who we share it with, and what rights you have over it, in compliance with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13,709/2018 — LGPD).

sections.title: 1. Who controls your data
sections.body: The controller of the data processed by Fluency Mind is Diego, who can be reached at contato@thefluencymind.com for any matter related to privacy and data protection, including exercising the rights described in this policy.

sections.title: 2. What data we collect
sections.body:
Account data: name, email, and password (or your Google account identity), used to create and secure your account.

Usage data: the messages you write in your English conversations, the final text of voice messages, the flashcards you create or save, your flashcard reviews, and your progress (XP, day streak).

Payment data: processed directly by Stripe; we only receive subscription confirmation and technical identifiers (such as your Stripe customer ID), never your card number.

Basic technical data: session information needed to keep you securely signed in.

sections.title: 3. Special handling of voice audio
sections.body: When you use voice mode, the audio is recorded in your browser, sent to the transcription service, and discarded immediately after the transcript is generated. We don't store audio files on our servers. We only keep the transcribed text and the final text you actually send (which you may have edited before sending).

sections.title: 4. What we use your data for
sections.body: We use your data to: run the conversation and error-analysis service; track your progress and avoid duplicate flashcards for the same type of error; process your subscription and payment; send essential communications about your account (signup confirmation, password recovery, billing notices); and improve the quality of the product.

sections.title: 5. Who we share your data with
sections.body:
We only share data with service providers that are strictly necessary to operate Fluency Mind, acting as data processors, never for advertising purposes:

• Supabase — database hosting and authentication.
• Artificial intelligence provider (currently OpenAI) — generating conversation responses, error analysis, and voice transcription.
• Stripe — processing subscription payments.

We don't sell your personal data and don't share it with third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.title: 6. International data transfer
sections.body: Some of the providers listed above process data on servers outside Brazil. In those cases, we require those providers to adopt adequate data protection safeguards, as provided for under the LGPD.

sections.title: 7. Legal basis for processing
sections.body: We process your data based on contract performance (providing the service you signed up for), your consent (for example, when you choose to use the microphone), and our legitimate interest in improving the product, always in a way that is proportional and doesn't harm your rights.

sections.title: 8. How long we keep your data
sections.body: We keep your data while your account is active. If you request account closure, we delete or anonymize your personal data, except where we need to retain some information due to a legal obligation (for example, payment tax records).

sections.title: 9. Your rights
sections.body: Under the LGPD, you can request at any time, at contato@thefluencymind.com: confirmation that we process your data; access to the data we hold about you; correction of incomplete or outdated data; anonymization, blocking, or deletion of unnecessary data; portability of your data; information about who we share your data with; and withdrawal of your consent, where applicable. We will respond to these requests within the timeframes set by law.

sections.title: 10. Security
sections.body: We use technical measures to protect your data, including Row Level Security on the database — ensuring each user can only access their own data — and encrypted connections between your browser and our servers.

sections.title: 11. Children and teenagers
sections.body: Fluency Mind is not directed at anyone under 18 and we don't knowingly collect data from children or teenagers.

sections.title: 12. Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be communicated by email or a notice within the service itself, with an updated date shown at the top of this document.

sections.title: 13. Contact
sections.body: For questions, requests, or complaints about this policy, contact us at contato@thefluencymind.com.
